items.html: And behold, also with regard to Adam himself, he gained by this: for now his body and his feet were all in the Garden of Eden, which is the Nukva of Atzilut — which was not entirely so even at the time of the second aspect. And behold, had Adam HaRishon not sinned with the Tree of Knowledge, he would have been able, through his prayers on that Sabbath day, to raise the worlds to other, much higher ascents, ascent after ascent, with each and every prayer — the evening prayer, the morning prayer, the additional prayer, and the afternoon prayer.
